result.instructions: Tools for Pocketlaw, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which contracts in Pocketlaw are waiting for a signature?"; "List the templates we can use for a new supplier agreement."; "Create a draft NDA from our standard template for Acme Ltd.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pocketlaw data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pocketlaw_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pocketlaw_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pocketlaw_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pocketlaw_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents with their name, status, template, sign status and metadata. Read only. GET /api/v1/documents.

tools.name: pocketlaw_search_documents
tools.title: Search documents
tools.description: List documents whose external metadata matches a filter, for example an id from your own system. Read only. POST /api/v1/documents/search.

external_metadata.description: Metadata key/value pairs the documents must carry.

tools.name: pocketlaw_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document by id, with its field values, attachments and sign request. Read only. GET /api/v1/documents/{id}.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List contract templates with their categories and locales. Use a template id with pocketlaw_create_document. Read only. GET /api/v1/templates.

tools.name: pocketlaw_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template by id, with its fields, field rules and conditional logic. Read only. GET /api/v1/templates/{id}.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List document folders with their parent ids. Read only. GET /api/v1/folders.

tools.name: pocketlaw_search_folders
tools.title: Search folders
tools.description: List folders matching a parent id or a name. Read only. POST /api/v1/folders/search.

parent_id.description: Only folders under this parent folder id.

exclude_traverse_only.description: Leave out folders that only hold other folders.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the Pocketlaw account (id, name, e-mail). Read only. GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_sign_providers
tools.title: List signing providers
tools.description: List the e-signature providers the account can use for sign requests. Read only. GET /api/v1/sign-requests/provider.

tools.name: pocketlaw_create_document
tools.title: Create a document from a template
tools.description: Create a new document from a template, with its field values. Creates a record only: nothing is sent for signature. Get the template id and its field ids first (pocketlaw_get_template). POST /api/v1/documents.

template_id.description: Pocketlaw template id to create the document from.

locale.description: Locale of the document, for example en-GB. Use a locale the template lists.

value.description: Value for the field, in the form the template field expects.

field_values.description: Field values, one entry per template field.

user_id.description: Pocketlaw user id that owns the document. Leave out for the API key's default.

folder_id.description: Folder id to file the document in.

external_id.description: Your own id for this document.

external_source.description: Name of the system that owns external_id.

external_metadata.description: Your own key/value metadata for this document.

annotations.title: Create a document from a template

tools.name: pocketlaw_update_document
tools.title: Update a document
tools.description: Change a document's name, field values or external metadata. Only the fields you pass change. Does not send the document for signature. PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}.

value.description: Value for the field, in the form the template field expects.

field_values.description: Field values, one entry per template field.

external_metadata.description: Your own key/value metadata to set.
